question: Specify a sourced canonical 21-mer sequence-query workload and test its exact-count semantic compatibility with the pilot.
scope: Define and author-check a source-backed canonical 21-mer sequence-query workload, preserving ordered repeated queries and explicit N/boundary rules; public E. coli reference as a replay fixture, no production-trace or speedup claim

upstream.mode: query sequence inputs (-s) against a canonical exact binary database, not a Bloom counter

reference.status: Previously exposed repository reference fixture; not a new corpus or production trace.

stream.canonical: lexicographic minimum of ACGT word and its reverse complement
stream.order: FASTA record order, increasing zero-based within-record start
stream.repeats: Keep every occurrence in original order, including repeated canonical words
stream.ambiguous_bases: Skip any window containing non-ACGT; do not bridge ambiguity or record boundaries
stream.selection: Deterministic sample of prefix positions using the session seed, emitted in positional order

checks: tiny explicit overlap, canonical, ambiguity-reset and contig-boundary examples
positive canonical-count equality for odd k
even-k palindromic negative control demonstrating factor-of-two incompatibility
64 prefix sample counts in rank2a, persisted8 and suffix_array versus direct oracle, forward canonical-window tally and certificate checker
source hashes, full repository suite, no changes to frozen records

resources.meaning: Benchmark-adapter acceptance target, not a measured production application limit.
resources.timing_claim: No throughput tuning, speedup or break-even experiment; measure generation/check cost and peak whole-process RSS only.

prior_exposure: Parent agent authored PR #5 in the immediately preceding session and read the same repository's public data/status. Delegated source review is part of this author session, not independent scientific review.
